scripts.pull-main: cd anita-app.github.io && git pull --force origin main
scripts.push-to-origin: cd anita-app.github.io && git push -u origin main
scripts.publish-to-github-pages: yarn add-all && yarn commit-with-message && yarn push-to-origin
scripts.deploy: yarn pull-main && yarn licenses && cglg --action=newRelease && yarn do-no-run-this-deploy-directly && cglg --action=closeRelease && yarn publish-to-github-pages
scripts.do-no-run-this-deploy-directly: yarn propagate-version && yarn build-landing && yarn build-app
